notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug in which a werewolf mage's defeat effect could cause the player to lose progress.
・Fixed a bug that the mermaid mage did not trigger the use effect when the opponent had a disable.
・Fixed a bug that prevented a pirate ship's effect from being triggered when the pirate ship's hand effect was achieved by the Sentinel.
・Fixed a bug that the sub targets destroyed by the CPU bear's victory effect were not correct.
・Fixed a bug that caused excessive consumption of magic power related to dragon users and dragon families.
・Fixed a bug that caused the game to become unplayable.

If there is a bug that causes the game to become inoperable, a logfile can be created on a local file by clicking on the button for saving the logfile.
Please create a logfile on your local file and report it to the official discord with a description of the situation.
I appreciate your cooperation in collecting information in the error log.

notes.title: Update version 1.1.0
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that only the HP of the attacker of the user's side was reduced to 0 when both attackers were ahead of each other under the effect of using the green dragon.
・Fixed a bug that when the Centaur Leader effect was applied and the opponent used a cavalryman, the sub was not destroyed and was not counted in the number of cavalryman destroyed.
・Fixed a bug that when a pair of Dragon Zombies are in the graveyard and a Dragon Zombie in the field leaves the battlefield due to movement, the effect of the Dragon Zombie in the graveyard is not activated.
・Fixed a bug that when a mermaid leader was used for a sub mermaid leader, the sub mermaid leader was not exchanged with the sub mermaid leader.
・Fixed a bug in which changing the volume during a match was not reflected in subsequent settings.
・Fixed a bug that caused the game to become unprogressable if the opponent had only daemons in his hand when using the Book of Black.
・Fixed a bug in which the daemons in the opponent's hand were not destroyed when the Death Mask Shooter destroys the opponent's hand.
Matching stability has been further improved.

The turn in which the amount of magical power increases by one was set to the fourth turn, and has been changed to the fifth turn.
Sound effects have been added to buffs and debuffs at the beginning of a turn, destruction, and effects.

A bug has now been reported that would cause the player to be unable to progress in versus battles.
If the bug occurs due to a specific card or a specific combination of cards, please report it to the discord.
Also, if you have an unstable connection, the connection from your opponent may time out and the game may stop progressing. Please check your connection environment.


[url=https://discord.gg/efcDWUR9rg]Check official discord![/url]

notes.title: Bug fixes including specification changes
notes.content:
・Conditions for the King of Conquerors quest have been relaxed and the wording changed.
・Fixed a bug that caused the game to become unprogressive when using deep-sea fish when either deck had 0 cards.
・Fixed a bug that caused the effect of a monster fire to decrease its value even if it increases its strength.
・Fixed a bug that Stegosaurus did not destroy all cards when there were multiple cards of the plant family in the waiting area.
・Fixed a bug that caused the CPU to put non-Dragon cards on the battlefield when using the Dragon Master's standby effect.
・Fixed a bug that prevented the player from progressing when using the medium in a versus game.
It is no longer possible to completely change the position of the hand. [strike]Goodbye cheating gamblers[/strike].
・The condition of the Book of Black has been changed from "If you have two or more black cards of level 6 or higher" to "If the leftmost card in your hand is a black card of level 6 or higher.
・Fixed a bug that caused the communication destination to be changed from the opponent after the game started, resulting in the opponent resigning or becoming unable to progress in the match against the opponent.
・Fixed a bug that allowed players to change decks while being matched against each other.
Currently, a bug has been identified in regards to the versus game and is currently being addressed.
